evidence_class: Retained independent live/source review; primary per-request raw JSON is not available in this export.
findings: Stream labels do not classify individual kernels; include all compute streams.
Overlap and D2H wait do not measure recoverable transfer cost.
Short text equality does not prove new dispatch tensor identity.
Greedy equality-based verification is not a random acceptance draw.
Tool HTTP500 existed in both compared controls; tool qualification was incomplete.
